t2.title: Handwriting still an important skill in the digital age
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Is handwriting still an important skill in the digital age?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
In our increasingly digital world, some question whether handwriting remains a valuable skill. I believe it continues to be important for several reasons.

Firstly, research shows that handwriting improves memory and learning. When students write notes by hand rather than typing, they process and retain information more effectively. The physical act of forming letters engages the brain differently than pressing keys.

Secondly, handwriting develops fine motor skills in children that are essential for other activities. These skills cannot be developed through typing alone. Schools should continue teaching cursive writing despite the prevalence of computers.

Furthermore, handwritten messages carry personal significance that typed text lacks. A handwritten thank-you note or birthday card shows thoughtfulness and effort that recipients genuinely appreciate.

However, I acknowledge that typing skills are equally important in modern workplaces. The solution is teaching both skills rather than abandoning handwriting entirely.

In conclusion, while technology has transformed how we communicate, handwriting remains a valuable skill that benefits learning, development, and personal expression. We should preserve this tradition alongside digital literacy.
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!
I like to write. It is fun. I can write my name. I like to draw too. Writing is good. Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
Hello!
I think writing is important. I can write letters to my grandma. She likes it. And I can write shopping lists. But typing is also good because it is fast. I use the computer for school. So, writing and typing are both important, I think.
t2.sampleB1:
I think handwriting is still important even though we use computers a lot now. For example, when I'm in class, I like to write notes because it helps me remember things better. Also, sometimes it's just easier to write something down quickly than to type it.

However, I know that typing is important too, especially for work. But I think kids should still learn how to write properly. It's a useful skill to have, and it's also nice to get a handwritten letter from someone. In my opinion, we shouldn't forget about handwriting just because we have computers.
t2.sampleB2: Great topic — I've been thinking about this a lot lately! In my opinion, handwriting is definitely still worth holding on to, even though we type almost everything these days. For a start, writing things down by hand really helps you remember them. Whenever I take notes in class by hand, the information seems to stick far better than when I type it on a laptop. On top of that, handwriting adds a personal touch that a text message simply can't match. A handwritten birthday card means so much more than a quick message on your phone — it shows you actually made an effort. That said, I completely get why some people think it's dying out. Typing is faster, tidier, and let's be honest, most jobs revolve around a keyboard nowadays. But I don't think it has to be one or the other. Schools should teach both, so kids can switch between them depending on the situation. So, what do you all think? Is handwriting a skill worth saving, or are we better off letting it fade away? I'd love to hear your thoughts!
t2.uzSample:
Bizning tobora raqamli dunyomizda ba'zilar qo'lyozuv qimmatli mahorat bo'lib qoladimi, degan savolni berishadi. Menimcha, u bir necha sabablarga ko'ra muhim bo'lib qolmoqda.

Birinchidan, tadqiqotlar shuni ko'rsatadiki, qo'lyozuv xotira va o'rganishni yaxshilaydi. Talabalar yozuv mashinkasida terishdan ko'ra qo'lda yozuvlar yozganda, ular ma'lumotni yanada samaraliroq qayta ishlaydi va eslab qoladi. Harflarni shakllantirishning jismoniy harakati miyani tugmalarni bosishdan farqli ravishda jalb qiladi.

Ikkinchidan, qo'lyozuv bolalarda boshqa faoliyatlar uchun zarur bo'lgan mayda motorika mahoratini rivojlantiradi. Bu ko'nikmalarni faqat terish orqali rivojlantirib bo'lmaydi. Kompyuterlar keng tarqalganiga qaramay, maktablar kursiv yozuvni o'rgatishni davom ettirishlari kerak.

Bundan tashqari, qo'lda yozilgan xabarlar terilgan matnda yo'q bo'lgan shaxsiy ahamiyatga ega. Qo'lda yozilgan minnatdorchilik xati yoki tug'ilgan kun kartasi oluvchilar chin dildan qadrlaydigan o'ylanganlik va sa'y-harakatni ko'rsatadi.

Biroq, men zamonaviy ish joylarida terish mahorati ham muhim ekanligini tan olaman. Yechim - qo'lyozuvdan butunlay voz kechishdan ko'ra, ikkala mahoratni ham o'rgatish.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, texnologiya bizning muloqot uslubimizni o'zgartirgan bo'lsa-da, qo'lyozuv o'rganish, rivojlanish va shaxsiy ifoda uchun foydali bo'lgan qimmatli mahorat bo'lib qolmoqda. Biz bu an'anani raqamli savodxonlik bilan birga saqlashimiz kerak.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!
Men yozishni yaxshi ko'raman. Bu qiziqarli. Men o'z ismimni yoza olaman. Men rasm chizishni ham yaxshi ko'raman. Yozish yaxshi. Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom!
Menimcha, yozish muhim. Men buvimga xatlar yozishim mumkin. Unga bu yoqadi. Va men xarid qilish ro'yxatlarini yozishim mumkin. Lekin terish ham yaxshi, chunki u tez. Men maktab uchun kompyuterdan foydalanaman. Shunday qilib, yozish ham, terish ham muhim, deb o'ylayman.
t2.uzSampleB1:
Menimcha, qo'lyozuv hozir kompyuterlardan ko'p foydalansak ham, hali ham muhim. Misol uchun, men darsda bo'lganimda, yozuvlar yozishni yaxshi ko'raman, chunki bu menga narsalarni yaxshiroq eslab qolishga yordam beradi. Bundan tashqari, ba'zan biror narsani tezda yozib qo'yish, uni terishdan ko'ra osonroq bo'ladi.

Biroq, men bilaman, terish ham muhim, ayniqsa ish uchun. Lekin menimcha, bolalar hali ham to'g'ri yozishni o'rganishlari kerak. Bu foydali ko'nikma va kimdandir qo'lda yozilgan xat olish ham yoqimli. Mening fikrimcha, biz kompyuterlarimiz borligi uchun qo'lyozuvni unutmasligimiz kerak.
t2.uzSampleB2:
Biz klaviaturalar va ekranlar hukmron bo'lgan raqamli asrda yashayotgan bo'lsak-da, men qo'lyozuv qimmatli ko'nikma sifatida o'z ahamiyatini saqlab qoladi, deb hisoblayman. Harflarni jismonan shakllantirish jarayoni terishdan farqli kognitiv jarayonlarni ishga soladi, bu esa xotira va tushunishni yaxshilashi mumkin. Tadqiqotlar shuni ko'rsatadiki, qo'lda eslatmalar olish noutbukda terishga qaraganda ma'lumotlarni yaxshiroq eslab qolishga olib keladi.

Bundan tashqari, qo'lyozuv raqamli aloqada ko'pincha etishmaydigan shaxsiy ta'sirni ta'minlaydi. Qo'lda yozilgan tabrik yoki xat elektron tarzda takrorlash qiyin bo'lgan o'ylanganlik va g'amxo'rlik darajasini ifodalaydi. Professional muhitda qo'lda yozilgan minnatdorchilik xati uzoq muddatli ijobiy taassurot qoldirishi mumkin.

Albatta, raqamli savodxonlik bugungi kunda juda muhim va terish bo'yicha malaka ko'plab ishlar uchun zarurdir. Biroq, qo'lyozuvni butunlay rad etish xato bo'ladi. Bu ijodkorlikni rivojlantiradigan, kognitiv funktsiyani yaxshilaydigan va shaxsiyroq aloqa shaklini ta'minlaydigan ko'nikma. Shuning uchun qo'lyozuvni raqamli ko'nikmalar bilan birga o'qitish va qadrlashni davom ettirish kerak.

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who is interested in eating healthier. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hey! I remember you mentioned wanting to eat healthier. I've started shopping at the farmers market and the difference is incredible! The fruits and vegetables are so fresh and taste amazing. Plus, you meet local farmers and learn where your food comes from. You'd absolutely love it! Take care!
t11.sampleA1:
Hi Kamron,
Market good. Food good. I like fruit. You come!
Bye.
t11.sampleA2:
Hi Kamron,
I go to the market. It is good! The food is fresh and I like it. You want to eat healthy, so you can go too. It is fun and the food is good. See you!
Bye,
t11.sampleB1:
Hi Kamron,

I wanted to tell you about the farmers market. I started going recently, and I really like it. The food is very fresh, and it tastes better than the supermarket. You said you want to eat healthier, so I think you should try it. It's a good way to get fresh food. Maybe we can go together next time?

Best,
Javohir Rahimov
t11.sampleB2: Hey Kamron! Guess what — I've finally started shopping at the local farmers market, and I honestly think you'd love it. The fruit and veg are so much fresher than the supermarket stuff, and you get to chat with the farmers who grow it. Since you're keen to eat healthier, why not come along with me this Saturday? Let me know! Take care, Bekzod Aliyev

Esimda, sog'lomroq ovqatlanishni xohlayotganingni aytganding. Men dehqon bozorida xarid qila boshladim va farqi juda ajoyib! Meva va sabzavotlar juda yangi va ta'mi ajoyib. Qolaversa, mahalliy dehqonlar bilan tanishasiz va ovqatingiz qayerdan kelishini bilib olasiz. Senga bu juda yoqadi!

O'zingni asra!
t11.uzSampleA1:
Salom Kamron,
Bozor yaxshi. Ovqat yaxshi. Menga meva yoqadi. Sen kel!
Xayr.
t11.uzSampleA2:
Salom Kamron,
Men bozorga boraman. Bu yaxshi! Ovqatlar yangi va menga yoqadi. Sen sog'lom ovqatlanmoqchisan, shuning uchun sen ham borishing mumkin. Bu qiziqarli va ovqatlar yaxshi. Ko'rishguncha!
Xayr,
t11.uzSampleB1:
Salom Kamron,

Sizga dehqon bozori haqida aytmoqchi edim. Yaqinda u yerga bora boshladim va menga juda yoqadi. Ovqat juda yangi va supermarketdagidan mazaliroq. Siz sog'lomroq ovqatlanishni xohlaysiz dedingiz, shuning uchun o'ylaymanki, siz ham urinib ko'rishingiz kerak. Bu yangi ovqat olishning yaxshi usuli. Balki keyingi safar birga borarmiz?

Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Javohir Rahimov
t11.uzSampleB2:
Aziz Kamron,

Umid qilaman, bu xat sizga yaxshi yetib borgan.

Sizga yaqinda mahalliy fermerlar bozorida bo'lgan tajribamni baham ko'rmoqchiman. Sog'lom ovqatlanishga qiziqishingizni bilganim uchun, bu sizga qiziq bo'lishi mumkin deb o'yladim. Men u yerda bir necha haftadan beri xarid qilmoqdaman va mahsulotlarning sifati va yangiligidan chin dildan hayratdaman. Bu odatda supermarketlarda topadigan narsalardan ancha farq qiladi. Ishonchim komilki, mahalliy manbalardan olingan oziq-ovqatlarni ratsioningizga kiritish sog'liq maqsadlaringizga erishish yo'lida muhim qadam bo'ladi. Albatta, uni tekshirib ko'rishingiz kerak!

Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Javohir Rahimov

t12.title: formal letter · to committee
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the farmers market committee. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear Greenfield Market Committee, Thank you for contacting me about my experience at your farmers market. I have been visiting for the past month and am delighted with the quality of produce available. The fruits and vegetables are noticeably fresher than supermarket alternatives, and I appreciate being able to speak directly with the farmers who grow them. The prices are reasonable considering the superior quality. However, I would like to suggest some improvements. Extending the market hours into the afternoon would accommodate people who work Saturday mornings. Additionally, providing more seating areas would allow visitors to enjoy purchased food on-site. I would also welcome more variety, such as artisan bread stalls and organic dairy products. The market has become a highlight of my weekend, and I will continue to support local farmers. Yours sincerely, Javohir Rahimov
t12.sampleA1:
Hi Greenfield Market!

I like fruit. Good. Vegetables good. I want more apples. Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Dear Greenfield Market Committee,

Thank you for the letter. I like the market. The food is good and fresh. The prices are okay, but sometimes they are expensive. I want more cheese and bread. And more flowers! I will come again next week.

Thanks,

Javohir Rahimov
t12.sampleB1:
Dear Greenfield Market Committee,

Thank you for asking about my experience at the farmers market. I think it's very good. The vegetables and fruit are fresh, and I like that I can buy local food. The prices are usually fair, but some things are expensive compared to the supermarket.

I think you could improve the market by having more things to buy. For example, I would like to see more cheese and maybe some homemade bread. Also, it would be good if the market was open later on Saturdays because I sometimes can't come in the morning. I will visit again soon.

Sincerely,
Javohir Rahimov
t12.sampleB2: Dear Greenfield Market Committee, Thank you for reaching out to ask about my experience at the market. I have been shopping there every Saturday for the past month, and I am genuinely delighted with what you offer. The produce is noticeably fresher than the supermarket alternatives, and I really value being able to speak directly with the farmers who grow it. On the whole, the prices are fair given the superior quality. That said, I would like to suggest a couple of improvements. Extending the opening hours into the early afternoon would help those of us who work on Saturday mornings. It would also be wonderful to see more variety, such as artisan bread stalls and organic dairy products. Thank you for all your hard work. I look forward to continuing to support our local farmers. Yours sincerely, Dilnoza Karimova
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli Greenfield bozor qo‘mitasi,

Sizning fermerlar bozoringizdagi tajribam haqida men bilan bog‘langaningiz uchun rahmat.

Men o‘tgan oy davomida tashrif buyurib kelmoqdaman va mavjud mahsulotlarning sifatidan juda mamnunman. Meva va sabzavotlar supermarketlardagi muqobillarga qaraganda ancha yangiroq ekanligi sezilarli, va ularni yetishtiradigan fermerlar bilan bevosita gaplasha olishimni qadrlayman. Narxlar yuqori sifatni hisobga olganda maqbul.

Biroq, men ba'zi takliflarni kiritmoqchiman. Bozor ish vaqtini tushgacha uzaytirish shanba kuni ertalab ishlaydigan odamlarga mos keladi. Bundan tashqari, ko'proq o'tirish joylarini ta'minlash tashrif buyuruvchilarga sotib olingan ovqatlardan joyida bahramand bo'lish imkonini beradi.

Men, shuningdek, hunarmandchilik non do'konlari va organik sut mahsulotlari kabi ko'proq xilma-xillikni xohlardim.

Bozor mening dam olish kunlarimning eng yorqin voqeasiga aylandi va men mahalliy fermerlarni qo'llab-quvvatlashda davom etaman.

Hurmat bilan,
Javohir Rahimov
t12.uzSampleA1:

Menga meva yoqadi. Yaxshi. Sabzavotlar yaxshi. Men ko'proq olma xohlayman. Xayr.
t12.uzSampleA2:
Hurmatli Greenfield Bozor Qo‘mitasi,

Xat uchun rahmat. Menga bozor yoqadi. Ovqat yaxshi va yangi. Narxlar yaxshi, lekin ba'zida qimmat. Men ko'proq pishloq va non xohlayman. Va ko'proq gullar! Men kelasi hafta yana kelaman.

Rahmat,

Javohir Rahimov
t12.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli Greenfield Bozor Qo'mitasi,

Dehqon bozoridagi tajribam haqida so'raganingiz uchun rahmat. Menimcha, u juda yaxshi. Sabzavotlar va mevalar yangi, va menga mahalliy mahsulotlar sotib olishim mumkinligi yoqadi. Narxlar odatda adolatli, lekin ba'zi narsalar supermarketga nisbatan qimmatroq.

Menimcha, siz bozorda sotib olish uchun ko'proq narsalar bo'lishi bilan bozorni yaxshilashingiz mumkin. Misol uchun, men ko'proq pishloq va ehtimol uyda tayyorlangan nonni ko'rishni xohlardim. Shuningdek, bozor shanba kunlari kechroq ochilsa yaxshi bo'lardi, chunki ba'zan ertalab kelolmayman. Men tez orada yana tashrif buyuraman.

Hurmat bilan,
Javohir Rahimov
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli Greenfield Bozor Qo'mitasi,

Greenfield Fermerlar Bozoriga oid fikr-mulohazalarni to'plash uchun murojaat qilganingiz uchun tashakkur. Men so'nggi bir necha haftadan beri doimiy ravishda tashrif buyuruvchiman va o'z fikrlarimni baham ko'rmoqchiman.

Umuman olganda, men mahsulotlarning sifati va yangiligidan hayratdaman. Bu supermarketlarda mavjud bo'lgan narsalardan sezilarli darajada ustun va men mahalliy qishloq xo'jaligini qo'llab-quvvatlashni qadrlayman. Narxlar odatda raqobatbardosh, garchi ba'zi narsalar biroz qimmatroqdek tuyuladi.

Ko'proq tez-tez tashrif buyurishni rag'batlantirish uchun bir nechta yaxshilanishlarni ko'rib chiqishni taklif qilaman. Birinchidan, bozor ish vaqtini uzaytirish, ehtimol erta tushgacha, shanba kuni ertalab majburiyatlari bo'lganlar uchun foydali bo'ladi. Ikkinchidan, mahsulot assortimentini diversifikatsiya qilish ko'proq xaridorlarni jalb qilishi mumkin. Men ayniqsa, ko'proq hunarmandchilik non mahsulotlari, mahalliy asal va hatto kichik partiyalarda tayyorlangan murabbolarni ko'rishdan manfaatdor bo'lardim.

Jamiyatimizni yangi, mahalliy mahsulotlar bilan ta'minlashga bo'lgan sadoqatingiz uchun tashakkur. Bozorda xarid qilishni davom ettirishni intiqlik bilan kutaman.

Hurmat bilan,
Javohir Rahimov
